motivation: CARRY-PNL-0031 qualified as a standalone low-vol funding mechanism, while CARRY-STACK-0033 rejected a conservative fully-funded idle-capital deployment. Current Hyperliquid Portfolio Margin is independently relevant because it is designed to offset spot inventory against short perps and may reduce capital consumption without changing the carry signal.
question: Which components of the frozen five-asset carry mechanism are currently eligible for capital-efficient Hyperliquid Portfolio Margin implementation, and what public reserve/market constraints must be satisfied before a live subaccount shadow test?

required_requests: l2Book for every classified target spot candidate and target perp

official_documentation_snapshot.portfolio_margin_use_case: official docs describe a carry trade where a spot balance offsets a short perp and the spot balance collateralizes the perp position
official_documentation_snapshot.current_mode_context: official Hyperliquid announcements in 2026 state Portfolio Margin has progressed to beta and supports BTC and HYPE as collateral, subject to account/cap requirements
official_documentation_snapshot.note: documentation claims are recorded as external context; runtime API reserve state is the machine-verifiable authority for current LTV/rates

asset_identity.BTC: official Hyperliquid API docs state app UI BTC/USDC maps to UBTC/USDC on mainnet HyperCore; this remap is allowed
asset_identity.other_targets: no wrapped/bridged/canonical candidate is automatically treated as economically identical solely because its ticker contains ETH/SOL/BNB/XRP
asset_identity.collateral_rule: a spot token is machine-classified as current collateral only when its exact token index appears in allBorrowLendReserveStates with numeric LTV > 0

required_diagnostics: map every borrow/lend reserve token index to current spot token metadata/name
report reserve LTV, oracle price, total supplied/borrowed, utilization, borrow yearly rate and supply yearly rate
identify every reserve with LTV > 0 and every reserve with observable borrowing liquidity
re-run target spot identity classification for BTC/ETH/SOL/BNB/XRP using current metadata
report whether each target has a current perp market
for each target report whether the selected/verified spot token itself has LTV > 0
for BTC and any other verified collateral-capable target, capture spot/perp spread, returned L2 depth and $1k/$10k/$50k/$100k marketable VWAP/slippage
compare observed USDC borrow yearly rate with a diagnostic annualized funding hurdle only as an implementation hurdle; do not create strategy PNL
explicitly distinguish Portfolio Margin collateral eligibility from mere Unified Account balance unification

qualification_rule.btc_carry_public_feasibility: BTC has verified UI-remapped spot identity, live BTC perp, selected BTC spot token LTV > 0, nonempty spot/perp books, and current public reserve state is readable
qualification_rule.multi_asset_pm_feasibility: report target-by-target only; do not require all five to pass because PM collateral eligibility is an implementation property, not a strategy selection rule
qualification_rule.decision: PASS for BTC authorizes a separate no-trade/small-subaccount Portfolio Margin shadow design; it does not authorize live capital or leverage. Other assets remain unsupported for collateral-efficient carry unless their exact selected spot token independently passes the same LTV rule.

prohibited: no change to CARRY-PNL-0031 assets or weights
no assumption that Unified Account equals Portfolio Margin offsetting
no inferred LTV for an asset absent from reserve state
no wrapped-token approval based only on name similarity
no private-key use or order placement
no leverage recommendation from this public snapshot
no assumption that current borrow/supply caps or rates remain stable
next_gate: If BTC public feasibility passes, separately preregister a Portfolio Margin subaccount shadow/probe that measures actual margin usage, health factor and capital release for matched BTC spot + short perp without strategy PNL optimization.
